_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd abiotic_factor/egg-abiotic-factor.yaml (pelican-eggs, MIT licence), converted to JSON. Octail adds the abiotic-factor tag, an automatic query port, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, the no_console_input flag (the server runs under Proton and reads no commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, makes the password optional (upstream required it with an empty default), adds an optional admin password (-AdminPassword) and the world save name (-WorldSaveName), limits players to the game's 1-24, refuses double quotes and backslashes in the name and password, traps Ctrl+C and waits for the server so it shuts down before the container ends (upstream's shell ended with the log tail), downloads SandboxSettings.ini from a pinned commit of DFJacob/AbioticFactorDedicatedServer and only when there is none (upstream overwrote it on every reinstall), drops the update URL (pinned), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Abiotic Factor
author: git@robsti.dev
description:
Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground
research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from
a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.

startup_commands.Default: cd /home/container/AbioticFactor/Binaries/Win64; xvfb-run -a proton run ./AbioticFactorServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -MaxServerPlayers={{NUM_PLAYERS}} -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -ServerPassword="{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" -SteamServerName="{{SERVER_NAME}}" -WorldSaveName="{{WORLD_SAVE_NAME}}" -SandboxIniPath="{{SANDBOX_INI_PATH}}" $( [ -z "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" ] || printf -- '-AdminPassword=%s' "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" ) & AF_PID=$!; trap "wait ${AF_PID}" INT TERM; tail -c0 -F /home/container/AbioticFactor/Saved/Logs/AbioticFactor.log --pid=${AF_PID} & wait ${AF_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'


# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/AbioticFactor/Binaries/Win64/AbioticFactorServer-Win64-Shipping.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Abiotic Factor dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## download the default server settings file (Octail: from a pinned commit, and only when there is none yet)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/AbioticFactor/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/AbioticFactor/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/SandboxSettings.ini ]]; then
    curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/AbioticFactor/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/SandboxSettings.ini https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DFJacob/AbioticFactorDedicatedServer/8c0065ed6b797c3abee86164743d8aa2558083dd/SandboxSettings.ini || { echo "Downloading SandboxSettings.ini failed."; exit 1; }
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: [SERVER] Number of Players
variables.description: Number of allowed player connections (1 to 24; more than 6 shows players a warning before they join).

variables.name: [SERVER] Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (A2S). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: [SERVER] Sandbox Ini Path
variables.description: Path to the sandbox ini file

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server in the server browser (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join; empty for none (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: [SERVER] Admin Password
variables.description: Optional: players who type this password in the game become admins (-AdminPassword). Empty turns it off; then add admins by Steam id in AbioticFactor/Saved/SaveGames/Server/Admin.ini.

variables.name: [SERVER] World Save Name
variables.description: The world save folder to use (in AbioticFactor/Saved/SaveGames/Server/Worlds/).
